docs-bot: Lighthouse scan completed: 28 'dead anchor' findings under /kb/ (run id 3081728390). Full report: https://internal.redwood/lighthouse/3081728390 erin: Heads up — the scan flagged a bunch of anchors in /kb/runtime/ after yesterday's sitemap move. Looks like a false positive wave. Anyone owning runtime KB? kevin: I think it's the fragment/query mismatch. Quick check shows anchors are present but scan strips fragments before lookup. Example quick check: `curl -sSf https://kb.redwood.com/runtime | grep 'id=\"kv-cache\"'` sarah: @kevin can you paste the grep output? I can open a PR to adjust the scanner rules to ignore `#session`/fragment variations if that's the cause. kevin: paste: `runtime.md:

KV cache

` and `runtime.md: ` — anchors exist, scanner probably normalizes URLs too aggressively. erin: If it's scanner config, we should whitelist `^/kb/runtime/` temporarily while we patch. Also need to reassign owner for those pages — @oliver were you the runtime doc owner last I saw? oliver: I can take ownership for the runtime KB this week. Plan: 1) small doc anchor consistency fixes, 2) submit whitelist/scan-rule PR, 3) rerun scan. Ping me with PR links. docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-4521: "Lighthouse false positives sweep" — assigned to oliver. Tracker: https://tickets.redwood/DOCS-4521 sarah: For the scanner change, recommend ignoring fragments and queries when checking anchors. Pseudocode: `normalized = url.split(/[#?]/)[0]` before anchor resolution. Also add unit test for fragment cases. erin: I started a tiny branch with fixes and a unit test: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2742 — sed to fix a couple of id mismatches + test for fragment-handling in scanner. @kevin @sarah can you review? aiming to merge today. kevin: :thumbsup: will review in ~1h oliver: I'll also run the lighthouse job locally once PR is up: `npm run lighthouse -- --target /runtime` and follow up in the ticket. sarah: If PR looks good we should re-run the nightly scan and then close DOCS-4521. Also let's ask SRE to mute the noisy alert during the patch window so we don't get paged repeatedly. @josh-oncall can you help? josh-oncall: oncall here — I can mute the alert for 2h starting when the PR merges. Ping me in this thread when ready and I'll schedule the mute. erin: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket and drop a merge note here when it's done :sparkles:
